title: Tax engine upgrade for EU VAT rules
executive_summary: ECR-2026-023 (Tax engine upgrade for EU VAT rules) is a backend change in the Finance domain, scored 68/100 (HIGH). It touches REQ-1015 (Invoice Generation and Numbering), REQ-1030 (Jurisdiction Tax Calculation), REQ-1011 (Order Total Calculation with Taxes). History is relevant here: BUG-410 (Tax rounded per line instead of per invoice), BUG-214 (Invoice numbering gap after failed transaction), BUG-221 (Invoice amount formatted with wrong currency symbol). Open concern: BUG-201 was reopened twice because the fix only checked code length. Please add the ISO-4217 catalogue assertion to the regression pack, not just the merchant list check. Recommended regression: 11 of 170 tests (93.5% reduction), 1 P0 and 7 P1. Evidence is missing for: REQ-1001, REQ-1002, REQ-1005, REQ-1011.

ecr_overview.title: Tax engine upgrade for EU VAT rules
ecr_overview.description: Upgrade the Tax Calculation Service rules for the new EU VAT one-stop-shop thresholds and round VAT per invoice in the Invoice Service instead of per line.

change_classification.summary: ECR-2026-023 is a backend change in the Finance domain affecting Tax Calculation, VAT Rules. 2 file(s) are declared on the change and 2 candidate component(s) were identified.

matched_requirements.title: Invoice Generation and Numbering
matched_requirements.description: A gap-free, sequential invoice number shall be issued per legal entity on order completion, with amounts formatted for the invoice currency.
matched_requirements.reason: Explicitly linked to the ECR in the change record.

matched_requirements.title: Jurisdiction Tax Calculation
matched_requirements.description: The Tax Calculation Service shall calculate tax by delivery jurisdiction, apply EU VAT rules for cross-border orders and round tax per invoice.
matched_requirements.reason: Explicitly linked to the ECR in the change record.

matched_requirements.title: Order Total Calculation with Taxes
matched_requirements.description: Order totals shall be computed as line items plus tax minus discounts, rounded per currency minor-unit rules before payment authorisation.
matched_requirements.reason: Literal match on change keywords: rules, calculation, round, line.

matched_requirements.title: Payment Validation Rules Engine
matched_requirements.description: The Payment Validator shall validate amount, currency code, merchant configuration and payment instrument before any authorisation call, returning a deterministic list of validation errors.
matched_requirements.reason: Literal match on change keywords: rules, engine.

matched_requirements.title: Subscription Renewal Charging
matched_requirements.description: The Subscription Billing Service shall charge each renewal in the plan currency and retry failed renewals on a schedule before suspending the subscription.
matched_requirements.reason: Traced through component CMP-021 identified in the change.

matched_requirements.title: Stock Reservation at Checkout
matched_requirements.description: The Inventory Service shall reserve stock for every line item before payment authorisation and shall release the reservation when authorisation fails or the order is cancelled.
matched_requirements.reason: Literal match on change keywords: service, line.

matched_requirements.title: Chargeback Dispute Handling
matched_requirements.description: The Chargeback Service shall submit dispute evidence before the scheme deadline and shall post each chargeback outcome to the ledger exactly once.
matched_requirements.reason: Literal match on change keywords: service, line.

matched_requirements.title: Card Payment Authorization
matched_requirements.description: The Payment Service shall authorise card payments against the acquirer, capture an authorisation code and persist the transaction with its currency, amount and merchant reference.
matched_requirements.reason: Literal match on change keywords: service.

matched_requirements.title: Currency Conversion Rate Sourcing
matched_requirements.description: The Currency Service shall refresh FX rates every 15 minutes from the treasury feed, cache them and expose the rate age with every conversion.
matched_requirements.reason: Literal match on change keywords: service.

matched_requirements.title: Full and Partial Refund Processing
matched_requirements.description: The Refund Service shall support full and partial refunds against a captured payment, never exceeding the remaining refundable amount.
matched_requirements.reason: Literal match on change keywords: service.

requirements.reason: Traced through component CMP-021 identified in the change.

requirements.title: Stock Reservation at Checkout
requirements.description: The Inventory Service shall reserve stock for every line item before payment authorisation and shall release the reservation when authorisation fails or the order is cancelled.
requirements.reason: Literal match on change keywords: service, line.

requirements.title: Chargeback Dispute Handling
requirements.description: The Chargeback Service shall submit dispute evidence before the scheme deadline and shall post each chargeback outcome to the ledger exactly once.
requirements.reason: Literal match on change keywords: service, line.

requirements.title: Card Payment Authorization
requirements.description: The Payment Service shall authorise card payments against the acquirer, capture an authorisation code and persist the transaction with its currency, amount and merchant reference.
requirements.reason: Literal match on change keywords: service.

requirements.title: Currency Conversion Rate Sourcing
requirements.description: The Currency Service shall refresh FX rates every 15 minutes from the treasury feed, cache them and expose the rate age with every conversion.
requirements.reason: Literal match on change keywords: service.

requirements.title: Full and Partial Refund Processing
requirements.description: The Refund Service shall support full and partial refunds against a captured payment, never exceeding the remaining refundable amount.
requirements.reason: Literal match on change keywords: service.

sections.title: Defect Analysis
sections.body: 10 past defect(s) are related to ECR-2026-023. These could happen again with this change: BUG-410 (Tax rounded per line instead of per invoice); BUG-214 (Invoice numbering gap after failed transaction). The most common causes were rounding error and transaction boundary. The recommended tests cover every defect that could come back. Still open in the affected area: BUG-421 (Checkout failed when the inventory service timed out, high).

defects.title: Tax rounded per line instead of per invoice
defects.root_cause: Rounding applied at the wrong aggregation level.
defects.why_it_matters: This change touches Tax Calculation Service, where the defect happened. It broke REQ-1030, REQ-1011, which this ECR also affects.
defects.what_to_check: Run TC-1160, TC-1083, TC-1088 to make sure it does not come back.

defects.title: Invoice numbering gap after failed transaction
defects.root_cause: Sequence allocated inside the transaction that rolled back.
defects.why_it_matters: This change touches Invoice Service, where the defect happened. It broke REQ-1015, which this ECR also affects.
defects.what_to_check: Run TC-1111, TC-1113, TC-1114 to make sure it does not come back.

defects.title: Order total mismatch versus authorised amount
defects.root_cause: Total recalculated after the authorisation request was built.
defects.why_it_matters: This change indirectly affects Order Service, where the defect happened. It broke REQ-1011, REQ-1001, which this ECR also affects.
defects.what_to_check: Run TC-1083, TC-1088 to make sure it does not come back.

defects.title: Invoice amount formatted with wrong currency symbol
defects.root_cause: Formatter defaulted to the locale currency.
defects.why_it_matters: This change touches Invoice Service, where the defect happened. It broke REQ-1015, which this ECR also affects. It reached production last time.
defects.what_to_check: Run TC-1111, TC-1113, TC-1114 to make sure it does not come back.

defects.title: Currency conversion failed for unsupported currencies
defects.root_cause: Missing guard clause for unknown currency codes in convert().
defects.why_it_matters: It broke REQ-1005, which this ECR also affects, but the change does not touch the code where it happened. It reached production last time.
defects.what_to_check: Low chance with this change. No extra check needed.

defects.title: Refund service failed after payment validation change
defects.root_cause: Shared validation library changed without refund regression run.
defects.why_it_matters: It broke REQ-1013, REQ-1002, which this ECR also affects, but the change does not touch the code where it happened. It reached production last time.
defects.what_to_check: Low chance with this change. No extra check needed.

defects.title: Partial refund exceeded remaining refundable amount
defects.root_cause: No row-level lock on the refund aggregate.
defects.why_it_matters: It broke REQ-1013, which this ECR also affects, but the change does not touch the code where it happened. It reached production last time.
defects.what_to_check: Low chance with this change. No extra check needed.

defects.title: Payment validation allowed invalid currency codes
defects.root_cause: Validation rule checked length only, not the currency catalogue.
defects.why_it_matters: It broke REQ-1002, which this ECR also affects, but the change does not touch the code where it happened. It reached production last time.
defects.what_to_check: Low chance with this change. No extra check needed.

defects.title: Rounding error on JPY payments
defects.root_cause: Minor-unit exponent hard-coded to 2.
defects.why_it_matters: It broke REQ-1011, which this ECR also affects, but the change does not touch the code where it happened. It reached production last time.
defects.what_to_check: Run TC-1083, TC-1088 to make sure it does not come back.

defects.title: Stale FX rate applied after cache refresh failure
defects.root_cause: Refresh failure swallowed, no rate-age assertion.
defects.why_it_matters: It broke REQ-1005, which this ECR also affects, but the change does not touch the code where it happened. It reached production last time.
defects.what_to_check: Low chance with this change. No extra check needed.
